name: College Application Helper for Parents
tagline: Helps parents polish a student's Common App, from activities list to college shortlist
description: Built for parents steering an application season. It works through the Common App piece by piece, tightening activities and honours entries and giving essay feedback, then helps assemble a smarter college list. Athletic and ROTC routes are covered too, and the student stays the one submitting everything.
author: steve_mlc
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
